snippet.title: The Sims Medieval Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Introducing the most hilarious The Sims Medieval trailer yet!  Starring Donald Faison as some of our beloved Medieval Heroes.   Build Your Kingdom, Create Your Heroes, Guide Them on Amazing Adventures!  Be sure to get your copy of The Sims Medieval Today!
